instructions: Apply the private forms schema and deploy the cms-forms Edge Function.
Save a validated draft and publish an immutable version for collection bindings to consume.
scopes: Public and authenticated versioned form delivery
Idempotent submission capture and session recovery
Form lifecycle and submission review dashboards
checks: Browser clients only call the CMS Source proxy.
Every submission references an immutable published version.
The connector schema is denied to anon and authenticated roles.
resources: Paired public, authenticated, administrator, and system endpoints
Private forms schema and cms-forms Edge Function
review: Publish a new immutable version instead of changing an existing version.
Use authenticated endpoints for forms that require a signed-in visitor.
Keep service-role and CMS connector secrets outside browser bundles.
Choose a submission retention period appropriate for the collected data.
syncNote: The CMS serves static Source contracts; Supabase owns immutable form versions and submission state.
